editorial:
Imagine you are on a fancy cruise ship when suddenly a gang of terrorists takes over, kills the captain, and locks everyone up. They are not just looking for money; they want a shipment of uranium hidden in the ship's safe. You get to follow a tough security officer and a cocktail waitress who happens to be a pro pickpocket. Together, they form an unlikely team to sneak around the ship and take down the bad guys. It feels like a classic 90s action flick where the stakes are high and the energy is always pumping. 

Since Yuen Woo-Ping is directing, you can expect the fight scenes to be top-notch and very creative. The pacing is quick, so you will not get bored, though some of the dialogue can be a bit cheesy. If you love high-stakes heists and cool martial arts, you will have a blast. For the best experience, you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video if you have it, or just rent it on Apple TV for a movie night. If you are a big collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, the security officer and the waitress use their combined skills to trick the terrorists. The waitress uses her nimble fingers to steal the key to the uranium safe right under their noses. After a massive fight scene on the deck, the security officer defeats the lead terrorist and stops the uranium from being stolen. The hostages are saved, and the two heroes share a sweet moment as the ship finally reaches safety.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves martial arts and heist movies.
